scope: Existing Johto and League/Mt. Silver approaches; not all SoulSilver
excluded: Safari Zone data, area maps, layout, mechanics, calculator and simulator
includedBoundary: Safari Zone Gate is an ordinary scoped location
outcome: No confirmed content discrepancy found in the performed checks; known completeness limits remain. No runtime/data changes were necessary.

knownLimits.detail: Full Kanto towns/routes/dungeons and Sinjoh Ruins are not implemented; existing border/endgame locations are included.
Town overview maps and grouped dungeon floors are present; maps for every individual house, Gym and service interior are not included. Some facilities explicitly use surroundings/reference views.
Connections do not render verified per-edge HM/story indicators or enforce one-way/ledge/progression rules. Reference navigation is not a game movement simulator.
Trainer rosters show species/levels and some held-item text. Complete move/EV/AI sets, generated Frontier opponent/rental pools and facility simulators are outside the current reference.
National-Dex, time, radio, outbreak, event and access conditions are labelled; active save progression does not automatically filter all conditional content or EV recommendations.
Reviewed named records and source tables are covered; this is not a census of every NPC dialogue or independent in-game verification of every interaction.
